rationale: A has a striking nocturnal timber-house hero and a strong pinned 'Five seasons' process drawing, but its entrance shows the full hero at 80 ms, blanks to an empty scene by 520 ms and rebuilds it, which reads as a flash of content. Its transparent header also collides with scrolled text on desktop (2025px, 12150px) and mobile (logo over 'Case study' and 'Listen to the site'). B builds a more cohesive art direction from the tree-ring motif, with a horizontal works gallery and a process elevation that draws itself site → frame → envelope → light, and it stays clean on mobile. B's hover states (Enquire/commission fill inversion, CTA lift, underlines) are clearer than A's custom cursor dot, which covers the text and leaves Contact and Selected Work almost unchanged.
